status: K1-double-prime step 1: fold dedup landed; real but partial improvement, K0-class latency not yet reached

change.cut: duplicate-contribution dedup inside the requirement fold
change.what: refresh_requirements resolves each contribution and skips terms already folded in this pass, preserving the original interleaved order (occurs check, then resolve, then merge) so payload-binding side effects stay identical
change.probe: debug-only BOON_KERNEL_TRACE_AGGREGATE records folds, visits, distinct visits, repeat folds and single-delta folds
change.verified_gates: kernel library 197, kernel_transfer 10, compiler library 98 with one pre-existing ignored probe, staged 3, map_set 3, nested_boolean_match 3, pulses 8

redundancy_measured.finding: TodoMVC re-merges each distinct term about twelve times per fold; NovyWave is mostly distinct, so dedup helps TodoMVC far more

latency_interleaved_ab.protocol: alternating one-process observations, same machine and load, 15 rounds, release producers

k0_comparison_post_reboot.protocol: interleaved K0 producer and dedup candidate, 10 rounds, one process per observation, fresh diagnostics
k0_comparison_post_reboot.finding: dedup moves the candidate from +28.9%/+81.7% versus K0 to +14.9%/+73.2%; the goal's K0-class gate is not met

next_step.target: make each remaining fold cheaper rather than only removing duplicates: NovyWave folds are 64% distinct, so the cost is genuine re-merging of about 29 contributions per fold
next_step.candidate_fast_path: when every distinct contribution in a fold is a closed term, build the union once and canonicalize once instead of pairwise-merging; probe how often all contributions are closed before implementing
next_step.gate: no diagnostic or oracle change, and cold TodoMVC/NovyWave moving further toward K0-class

decomposition_after_dedup.finding: the remaining cold gap is transfer-program evaluation, not aggregation. A three-node owner with one call compiles into a 2,316-node program with 2,314 inputs because nested callees are inlined transitively and every formal-root projection becomes a distinct input; each evaluation resolves those inputs. Aggregation after dedup costs about 57k (TodoMVC) and 122k (NovyWave) fact visits, which cannot explain the remaining +14.9% / +73.2% versus K0.

decision.outcome: reviewed rejection of aggregation sufficiency, with the aggregation win preserved
decision.what_landed: contribution dedup inside the fold: 722,579 to 56,796 fact visits and 1,189,597 to 390,804 object internings on TodoMVC, with interleaved A/B latency -3.9% (TodoMVC) and -8.1% (NovyWave)
decision.why_not_k0_class: the residual gap is dominated by transfer-program size and input resolution: NovyWave summary node evaluations 462,003 to 1,818,701 and definition nodes 12,866 to 101,753, traced to transitive inlining exploding formal projections into thousands of inputs per program
decision.next_architectural_decision: open Goal C, conditional linked transfer code: stop inlining nested callees into parent transfer programs and evaluate shared transfers through bound occurrence frames, starting with the definitions whose programs exceed a few hundred nodes
